description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between paper number and time cost in seconds for two different scenarios, as indicated by the legend: a blue line labeled “w/o Pre-computation” and an orange line representing the alternative. The x-axis, labeled “Paper Number,” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 256, with tick marks at intervals of 2 (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256). The y-axis, labeled “Time Cost (s),” is linear and spans from 0 to 35 seconds. The blue line, representing the scenario without pre-computation, starts at approximately 0.5 seconds for paper number 1 and exhibits a steep upward trend, reaching nearly 35 seconds by paper number 256. In contrast, the orange line remains nearly flat throughout the entire range, staying consistently at approximately 0.5 seconds regardless of the paper number.
